messages:
Tara (Design): shared a compact mock for the latency card. goals: make p95 'sticky' while scrubbing, show an unobtrusive "sampled" indicator when sampling is active, and add keyboard shortcuts for the time scrubber. figma: https://figma.com/... :sparkles:
Ben (PM): love it. product Q: when we auto-apply sampling, do we show a banner or only the sampled tag? my vote: both (banner briefly + tag persistent).
Ish (Frontend): banner + tag works. impl note: scrubbing currently fires full heatmap fetches; recommend debounce 120ms for pointer, 70ms for keyboard. also avoid refetch if only bucket offset changed. pseudo: `fetchHeatmap({start,end,sample,debounce:120})`
Ravi (SRE): debounce numbers ok. also request client-side smoothing (1.5s) for p95 visual to prevent bucket hop. add telemetry: `viz.sampling_on` and `viz.p95_sticky_interaction` events so ops can query incidents where sampling masked spikes.
Maya (A11y): quick a11y checklist:
- scrubber must be role=\"slider\" and support arrow/shift+arrow/pageup/pagedown. announce `aria-valuetext` as "range: 09:30 to 10:00"
- when sampling is applied announce via aria-live polite: "Sampling applied: results may be approximate"
- ensure the sampled tag is focusable and when focused reads "sampled" after p95 value
Tara (Design): for microcopy i'm proposing: label = "Sample rate" tooltip = "Applied to large ranges to reduce query cost; values may be approximate." Short and consistent across UI.
Ben (PM): that copy is good. banner copy: "Sampling applied — some values may be approximate" (auto-dismiss after 6s).
Ish (Frontend): agree on copy. I'll wire `meta.sampled` in payload so we can toggle the tag without extra calls. locking on debounce pointer=120ms, keyboard=70ms, smoothing=1.5s.
Ravi (SRE): will add telemetry and a Grafana alert to catch correlation between `viz.sampling_on` and missed regressions. also suggest an "Exact" toggle in the chart menu to request raw un-smoothed values for debugging.
Maya (A11y): i'll test with NVDA and VoiceOver. focus order: presets -> scrubber -> sampling control -> p95 pill -> chart menu. ensure aria-live fires when exact toggle is used.
design-ci-bot: opened PR #5210 for "sticky-p95 + sampled-badge + a11y" and added reviewers @Ish @Maya :robot_face:
Tara (Design): thanks all! next: Ish implements PR, Maya reviews a11y, Ravi wires telemetry, Ben signs off on copy. will update figma after PR merges :heart:
